lines.zh: 洞壁擦过我的鳞背，这条路我熟。
lines.en: The cave wall scrapes my back; I know this path.

lines.zh: 石缝里的回声替我数着脚步。
lines.en: The echo in the cracks counts my steps for me.

lines.zh: 我贴着洞顶走，倒着也不掉。
lines.en: I walk along the ceiling and never fall.

lines.zh: 脚爪踩碎苔藓，声音闷在洞里。
lines.en: My claws crush moss; the sound stays in the cave.

lines.zh: 这条隧道我爬过四百次。
lines.en: I have crawled this tunnel four hundred times.

lines.zh: 钟乳石的水，正好滴在我头上。
lines.en: The stalactite drips right onto my head.

lines.zh: 别跟丢了，拐角后面更黑。
lines.en: Do not fall behind; the corner ahead is darker.

lines.zh: 我的影子先在石壁上拐了弯。
lines.en: My shadow bends around the stone wall first.

lines.zh: 岩壁太窄，我只能侧身挤过去。
lines.en: The rock is too narrow; I squeeze through sideways.

lines.zh: 我朝光走，光那边有活的东西。
lines.en: I walk toward the light, where something lives.

lines.zh: 六十五点血的脚步，走得很稳。
lines.en: Sixty-five points of blood walk very steadily.

lines.zh: 洞口一吹风，我的绿皮就绷紧。
lines.en: When the cave mouth gusts, my green hide tightens.

lines.zh: 我对着石壁呼气，它不回话。
lines.en: I breathe at the stone; it does not answer.

lines.zh: 洞里没有白天，我懒得计数。
lines.en: There is no daylight here; I stopped counting.

lines.zh: 我嚼一块带硫磺味的石头。
lines.en: I chew a stone that tastes of sulfur.

lines.zh: 远处那声滴水，我听了六年。
lines.en: I have listened to that drip for six years.

lines.zh: 火药在我血管里慢慢沉淀。
lines.en: Gunpowder settles slowly in my veins.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴盘进石缝取暖。
lines.en: I coil my tail into a crack for warmth.

lines.zh: 洞顶有只蝙蝠倒挂着，像我。
lines.en: A bat hangs above, upside down like me.

lines.zh: 我数洞顶的裂缝，数到十七。
lines.en: I count the cracks overhead and reach seventeen.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，我的皮自己会响。
lines.en: When it is quiet, my hide clicks on its own.

lines.zh: 我在等一个不该来的脚步声。
lines.en: I wait for a footstep that should not come.

lines.zh: 你举着火把，绿光里我看见你的眼。
lines.en: You hold a torch; I see your eyes in the green light.

lines.zh: 你比上一个人矮，也比他慢。
lines.en: You are shorter than the last one, and slower.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的靴子，那儿有个洞。
lines.en: I stare at your boots; there is a hole in them.

lines.zh: 你在洞口停下，我真高兴。
lines.en: You stopped at the cave mouth; I am glad.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在洞里放大了三倍。
lines.en: Your breathing is three times louder down here.

lines.zh: 我看你的手，看你有没有弓。
lines.en: I look at your hands, checking for a bow.

lines.zh: 你身后那盏灯，照不到我这里。
lines.en: That lamp behind you cannot reach me.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，我靠眨眼量距离。
lines.en: Do not blink; I measure distance by blinks.

lines.zh: 你的影子投在石壁上，真长。
lines.en: Your shadow on the wall is very long.

lines.zh: 我把头歪过去，听你的心跳。
lines.en: I tilt my head and listen to your pulse.

lines.zh: 你砍开我的皮，火药漏出来了。
lines.en: You split my hide; gunpowder is leaking out.

lines.zh: 疼，但我更想咬你。
lines.en: It hurts, but I want to bite you more.

lines.zh: 这一下打在肩上，骨头没断。
lines.en: That landed on my shoulder; the bone held.

lines.zh: 我挪开半步，只为咬得更准。
lines.en: I shift half a pace to bite more cleanly.

lines.zh: 血是黑的，别嫌脏。
lines.en: My blood is black; do not complain.

lines.zh: 你力气不小，洞里都听得见。
lines.en: You hit hard; the whole cave can hear it.

lines.zh: 我的皮裂了，还会长回来。
lines.en: My hide split; it will grow back.

lines.zh: 别停手，停下来我就近了。
lines.en: Do not stop; if you stop, I am closer.

lines.zh: 你砍偏了，砍在石壁上。
lines.en: You missed and struck the wall.

lines.zh: 这一刀只是让我更饿。
lines.en: That cut only made me hungrier.

lines.zh: 食物？我只吃岩缝里的硫磺。
lines.en: Food? I only eat sulfur from the rock seams.

lines.zh: 你手里那块面包，闻起来像木头。
lines.en: That bread in your hand smells like wood.

lines.zh: 别晃那块肉，我不吃熟的。
lines.en: Stop waving that meat; I do not eat cooked things.

lines.zh: 我饿，但不吃你带的东西。
lines.en: I am hungry, but not for anything you carry.

lines.zh: 你放下食物也没用，我要的是你。
lines.en: Dropping food will not help; I want you.

lines.zh: 我的牙是为咬骨头长的。
lines.en: My teeth grew for bone, not for bread.

lines.zh: 那块饼太干，洞里到处是水。
lines.en: That cake is too dry; there is water everywhere here.

lines.zh: 你喂我，我也不会记住你。
lines.en: Feed me and I still will not remember you.

lines.zh: 我闻到的是火药，不是麦子。
lines.en: I smell gunpowder, not wheat.

lines.zh: 收起来吧，省得沾上灰。
lines.en: Put it away before it gets dusty.

lines.zh: 撞上我，你的膝盖会记住。
lines.en: Bump into me and your knee will remember.

lines.zh: 我皮下的火药被压得发响。
lines.en: The gunpowder under my skin crackles when pressed.

lines.zh: 别推，我贴着石壁已经够紧了。
lines.en: Do not shove; I am already tight against the wall.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我的爪子跟一步。
lines.en: You step back once; my claws follow one step.

lines.zh: 我的肩膀很硬，是石头做的。
lines.en: My shoulder is hard; it is made of stone.

lines.zh: 我们一碰，洞里全是回声。
lines.en: We collide and the cave fills with echo.

lines.zh: 你把我的尾巴踩进碎石里了。
lines.en: You pressed my tail into the gravel.

lines.zh: 这个拐角只够一个身子过。
lines.en: This corner only fits one body through.

lines.zh: 我顶开你，像顶开一块松石。
lines.en: I push you aside like a loose rock.

lines.zh: 别再靠近，我的皮在鼓起来。
lines.en: Stay back; my hide is swelling.

lines.zh: 我们这种生物，从火药堆里长出来。
lines.en: Our kind grows out of piles of gunpowder.

lines.zh: 我没有伴侣，只有一窝同脸。
lines.en: I have no mate, only a nest of identical faces.

lines.zh: 洞里太挤，容不下第二只我。
lines.en: The cave is too crowded for a second me.

lines.zh: 同类的味道，我隔很远就闻到。
lines.en: I smell my own kind from very far away.

lines.zh: 交配？我们只是分裂出新的。
lines.en: Mating? We simply split off new ones.

lines.zh: 母体在洞底，谁也没见过她。
lines.en: The mother lies at the cave bottom; no one has seen her.

lines.zh: 我的孩子出生就带火药味。
lines.en: My young are born already smelling of gunpowder.

lines.zh: 这块地盘只养得起一只。
lines.en: This territory only feeds one of us.

lines.zh: 同类相遇，我们只互相闻一闻。
lines.en: When kin meet, we only sniff each other.

lines.zh: 别指望我温柔，我没那根筋。
lines.en: Do not expect tenderness; I lack that nerve.

lines.zh: 我没有手，捡不起你的剑。
lines.en: I have no hands; I cannot pick up your sword.

lines.zh: 地上那把断箭，我用牙咬起来。
lines.en: That broken arrow on the ground, I bite it up.

lines.zh: 我只捡石头，塞进窝里。
lines.en: I only pick up stones to stuff into my nest.

lines.zh: 你掉的皮甲，我看不上。
lines.en: The leather armor you dropped does not impress me.

lines.zh: 火药我自己产，不用捡。
lines.en: I make my own gunpowder; no need to scavenge.

lines.zh: 这块燧石不错，我要了。
lines.en: This flint is good; I am taking it.

lines.zh: 我用嘴拖走你的镐子。
lines.en: I drag your pickaxe away in my mouth.

lines.zh: 这洞里所有东西都是我的。
lines.en: Everything in this cave belongs to me.

lines.zh: 捡东西会弄响我，不划算。
lines.en: Picking things up rattles me; not worth it.

lines.zh: 别在我面前丢东西。
lines.en: Do not drop things in front of me.

lines.zh: 你的火把照亮了我的晚饭。
lines.en: Your torch just lit up my dinner.

lines.zh: 脚步声进了洞，我就醒了。
lines.en: A footstep entered the cave, and I woke.

lines.zh: 你踩断的那根骨头，替你报了名。
lines.en: That bone you snapped announced you for me.

lines.zh: 我看见你的轮廓，够近了。
lines.en: I see your outline; close enough.

lines.zh: 六十五点血，够我慢慢玩。
lines.en: Sixty-five points of blood is enough to play with.

lines.zh: 你不该拐进这条岔道。
lines.en: You should not have turned into this side tunnel.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子替你签了到。
lines.en: My nose has signed you in.

lines.zh: 石壁把你的味道推给我。
lines.en: The wall pushes your scent toward me.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味，我很喜欢。
lines.en: I like the smell of iron on you.

lines.zh: 别跑了，出口在我背后。
lines.en: Do not run; the exit is behind me.

lines.zh: 我听见你在数台阶。
lines.en: I hear you counting the steps.

lines.zh: 你把火把举高了，真贴心。
lines.en: You raised the torch; how thoughtful.

lines.zh: 这一窝里，我先选中你。
lines.en: Of this nest, I choose you first.

lines.zh: 你身后没有路，只有我。
lines.en: There is no road behind you, only me.

lines.zh: 火光一矮，我就知道有人。
lines.en: The torchlight dips. Someone is here.

lines.zh: 你踢到的石子，滚到我脚边。
lines.en: The stone you kicked rolled to my feet.

lines.zh: 我绕到你侧后，石壁帮我挡光。
lines.en: I circle behind you; the wall hides me from the light.

lines.zh: 三步，两步，我一直数着。
lines.en: Three steps, two steps, I keep counting.

lines.zh: 你一转头，我就停下。
lines.en: You turn your head, and I stop.

lines.zh: 我在等你踩上那块松动的石板。
lines.en: I am waiting for you to step on that loose slab.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸和滴水声一个节奏。
lines.en: My breathing keeps time with the dripping.

lines.zh: 你退到死角了，很好。
lines.en: You have backed into a dead end; good.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴扫碎石，试探你。
lines.en: I sweep gravel with my tail to test you.

lines.zh: 你听不见我，洞壁替你听。
lines.en: You cannot hear me; the walls hear for you.

lines.zh: 我不急，洞里没有白天。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; there is no daylight here.

lines.zh: 你每走一步，我的皮就紧一分。
lines.en: Every step you take tightens my hide.

lines.zh: 我闻到汗味了，你快撑不住。
lines.en: I smell sweat; you are close to breaking.

lines.zh: 火光往左偏，你就会往左走。
lines.en: The light leans left, so you will go left.

lines.zh: 我留着出口，诱你回头。
lines.en: I leave the exit open to bait you back.

lines.zh: 六十五点血，我等得起。
lines.en: Sixty-five points of blood; I can afford to wait.

lines.zh: 我贴着石壁走，你看不见。
lines.en: I slide along the wall where you cannot see.

lines.zh: 洞里回声多，你分不清我。
lines.en: Too many echoes here. You cannot place me.

lines.zh: 我等你走到最窄的那段。
lines.en: I wait for you to reach the narrow stretch.

lines.zh: 火把烧短了，你就会慌。
lines.en: Your torch is burning low. You will panic.

lines.zh: 你数错了岔路，我数对了。
lines.en: You miscounted the turns. I did not.

lines.zh: 我吸了口气，你停了一下。
lines.en: I breathe in and you freeze for a moment.

lines.zh: 我一头撞在你胸口，肋骨响了。
lines.en: I headbutt your chest; a rib answers.

lines.zh: 我的牙咬进靴子，不松口。
lines.en: My teeth sink into your boot and stay.

lines.zh: 这一撞，是从洞顶借的力。
lines.en: This blow borrowed force from the ceiling.

lines.zh: 你挡住了，手臂却麻了。
lines.en: You blocked it, but your arm went numb.

lines.zh: 我撕开你的袖子，血是热的。
lines.en: I tear your sleeve open; the blood is warm.

lines.zh: 石壁的回音替我加了声势。
lines.en: The wall's echo doubles my swing.

lines.zh: 我的爪在石头上磨过，很利。
lines.en: My claws were sharpened on stone.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我就再咬一口。
lines.en: You retreat a step, and I bite again.

lines.zh: 这一下够你记住这条隧道。
lines.en: This one will make you remember the tunnel.

lines.zh: 我闻到你血里的铁味了。
lines.en: I smell the iron in your blood now.

lines.zh: 别用手挡，牙会穿过去。
lines.en: Do not block with your hand; the teeth go through.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，自己也摔了一跤。
lines.en: I lunge, and fall over with the blow.

lines.zh: 你膝盖一软，我正好咬到。
lines.en: Your knee buckles, and my teeth find it.

lines.zh: 洞口的风把你的喊声吹散了。
lines.en: The cave wind scatters your shout.

lines.zh: 我从侧面撞过来，很快。
lines.en: I hit you from the side. Quick.

lines.zh: 一口下去，咬到手背了。
lines.en: My teeth find the back of your hand.

lines.zh: 牙磕在护甲上，我不疼。
lines.en: Teeth on armor. It does not hurt me.

lines.zh: 这一扑，把你的火把撞灭了。
lines.en: My lunge knocks your torch out cold.

lines.zh: 我咬住衣角，往后拽。
lines.en: I bite your hem and pull backward.

lines.zh: 撞完我就退，等你松手。
lines.en: I hit and back off, waiting for you to drop guard.

lines.zh: 我从蠕变维度的石缝里挤出来。
lines.en: I squeeze out of a seam in Creeponia's stone.

lines.zh: 火药先在我胸口亮了一下。
lines.en: Gunpowder flickers in my chest first.

lines.zh: 这块岩壁本来是没有缝的。
lines.en: This wall had no seam before tonight.

lines.zh: 我一出生就闻到你的方向。
lines.en: I smelled which way you were the moment I was born.

lines.zh: 洞里多了一双绿眼睛。
lines.en: The cave gained another pair of green eyes.

lines.zh: 我从潮湿的黑暗里长齐了牙。
lines.en: I grew my teeth out of the wet dark.

lines.zh: 石屑还挂在我背上。
lines.en: Stone dust still clings to my back.

lines.zh: 这口洞终于有主人了。
lines.en: This cave finally has an owner.

lines.zh: 我的第一声，是一句嘶鸣。
lines.en: My first sound was a hiss.

lines.zh: 我从洞底往上爬了三十格。
lines.en: I climbed thirty blocks up from the cave floor.

lines.zh: 你点的火把，把我引醒了。
lines.en: The torch you lit called me awake.

lines.zh: 黑暗里，多了一层硫磺味。
lines.en: The dark gained a layer of sulfur smell.

lines.zh: 火？洞里最不缺的就是火星。
lines.en: Fire? Sparks are the least scarce thing in a cave.

lines.zh: 摔下来不疼，石头先碎了。
lines.en: Falling does not hurt; the stone breaks first.

lines.zh: 洞水淹不死我，只让我更沉。
lines.en: Cave water will not drown me, only weigh me down.

lines.zh: 这爆炸声我熟，像同类在打招呼。
lines.en: I know that blast; it sounds like kin saying hello.

lines.zh: 箭卡在我背脊的硬皮里。
lines.en: The arrow is lodged in the hard hide of my spine.

lines.zh: 甜味钻进骨头，我很不喜欢。
lines.en: That sweetness crawls into my bones; I dislike it.

lines.zh: 洞里没吃的，我就咬石头。
lines.en: When the cave has no food, I bite stone.

lines.zh: 雷声顺着洞口灌进来，我发抖。
lines.en: Thunder pours down the cave mouth; I shiver.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有石壁，我很不习惯。
lines.en: There are no walls in the void; I am not used to it.
